summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial studies the effects of the drug semaglutide on people who have plaque psoriasis, are overweight or obese, and may also have type 2 diabetes. Sponsored by Hospital Universitario Dr. Jose E. Gonzalez, the study is currently recruiting 62 participants. Researchers will compare semaglutide to an inactive substance called a placebo over a period of 12 weeks. Psoriasis is a condition that causes red, scaly patches on the skin.
